headline: Jack Henry Named a Best Company to Work For in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 - 2027 Ranking
summary: Jack Henry® (Nasdaq: JKHY) has been recognized as one of the 2026 – 2027 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News & World Report. This is the third consecutive year Jack Henry has earned this distinguished honor, reflecting the company's ongoing commitment to creating a supportive workplace and delivering a meaningful experience to its associates.
